title: Console micro-animation & lightweight asset kit for first-run onboarding
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a compact, themeable micro-animation and illustrative asset kit to power the console first-run tour, empty-state placeholders, and inline tip overlays. Assets must be lightweight (prefer SVG + bodymovin JSON where feasible), support dark/light theming, include accessible fallbacks, and be documented for engineers and PMs. Deliverables: Figma components, production-optimized animation JSONs (Lottie/bodymovin), SVG sprites for static illustrations, screenshot composites for release notes, and an implementation guidance doc that covers performance budgets and accessibility considerations.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with reusable components and tokens for 6 micro-animations and 8 illustration states
Exported Lottie JSONs (or animated SVG alternatives) under 120KB each and validated in the console harness
SVG sprite set with 2 color theme variants and CSS token mapping documented
Empty-state screenshot composites (3 sizes) showing how assets integrate with checklist and primary CTA
Implementation guide (Confluence) with performance budget, fallback behaviour, and QA checklist
Design review signed off by PM and front-end lead, and engineering spike scheduled
comments: 2026-03-02 - Maya Thompson: Initial scoping complete. Proposed micro-animation list attached to Figma. Recommended budget: 80-120KB per animation using limited vector shapes and trimmed keyframes.
2026-03-04 - Ravi Singh (PM): Please include a suppressed-animation variant for low-power devices and an explicit ARIA-friendly fallback for screen readers.

2026-03-06 - Emily Park (Design Lead): Prefer SVG-based illustrations for static empty-states to allow easy color theming; reserve Lottie for motion that communicates state change (e.g., checklist progress).
2026-03-08 - Liam Patel (Assignee): Raised an engineering concern about initial load cost. Proposed preload strategy and local caching in the console assets pipeline. Added implementation spike PR.
2026-03-10 - Frontend Eng (J. Alvarez): Reviewed export constraints. Requesting final Lottie JSONs be validated by the runtime harness and provide a CSS class map for toggle between dark/light.
2026-03-11 - Maya Thompson: Updated Figma with reduced shape complexity, exported test JSONs, and uploaded dark mode variants to Drive.
updates: 2026-03-03 - Wireframes and motion sketches completed. Prioritized six micro-interactions: checklist-pulse, CTA-entrance, tip-pop, empty-state-breathe, progress-swipe, and subtle-hint-loop.

2026-03-05 - Chosen technical approach: SVG sprites for static illustrations, Bodymovin/Lottie JSON for micro-interactions with a CSS-driven pause/play API. Decision rationale: largest compatibility across React stack and simple theme switching.

2026-03-07 - Accessibility decision: Provide static SVG fallback with descriptive <title> and ARIA labels; animations must be preferrably-reduced-motion aware via prefers-reduced-motion and console toggle.
2026-03-09 - Export pass 1 complete: 6 Lottie JSONs (raw), 8 SVGs (light/dark variants). Size reductions applied (path simplification + grouping).
2026-03-12 - Design review scheduled; added QA checklist and implementation notes to Confluence. Preparing screenshot composites for release-2026.04 notes.
